page: Microsoft Azure F16as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Fasv6 family, powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. It features 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable, allowing connection to external high-performance storage volumes.

In benchmark evaluations, the F16as_v6 demonstrates strong single-core and multi-core capabilities. It achieves top-tier performance in small-model LLM text generation and strong results in single-core stress-ng tests, Geekbench single-core and multi-core scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Standard operations, including memory bandwidth, Redis SET operations, static web serving throughput, and medium-to-large LLM inference workloads, consistently fall within the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F16as_v6 offers a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose and moderately compute-intensive workloads without the overhead of local storage or specialized GPU hardware. The dedicated CPU allocation and advanced instruction support, such as AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration, make it well-suited for web serving, text and image processing, software compilation, and database operations.
